laslo magzel.name: Laslo Magzel
laslo magzel.origin: Lazlo claimed to be a Mutant an immortal of Slorenian origin, and than his talent for design made him valued by various governments. He designed The Program used to empower the current Slorenian champion, Volkvhy. He also apparently designed Black Brigade's cybernetics. However, he claimed to be denied any reward for his work, or even allowed to use the Program to recharge his power. However, he grew 'bored' with his activities, looking for some fun to pass the time as an immortal. Building an armor and traveling to the US, he joined up with Sanction and Gunship to form the Rush Club. They had already defeated an unknown number of other wearers before dealing with Quarry. Quarry agreed to fight them, but then tried to leave with his Prey armour. Gunship pursued him, attempting to kill him, but Quarry was saved when he managed to run into James Rhodes. As War Machine, Jim battled the group. War Machine continued to follow the group, defeating Gunship. Laslo deemed that they must keep their games secret and that further confrontations with War Machine would be foolish. They set up an ambush with Sanction using an EMP to temporarily stop Jim. Laslo took War Machine to Slorenia. He said the Rush Club was no more and Jim's heroism had convinced him to do something about the various atrocities done by the current Slorenian government. In actuality, he was trying to use the centuries-old civil war to his benefit. The two fought their way to a palace that served as Ember's base. War Machine battled Black Brigade as Locomotive Breath made his way to Ember's "Triptych", planning to use its energies just as he had used Volkvhy's "program". In the cellars beneath the palace, Locomotive Breath managed to locate the Triptych. War Machine caught up with him and attacked, but Locomotive Breath struck him away, and opened the Triptych, only to be overwhelmed and seemingly destroyed by its power.
powers: Talent for design similar to that of Forge. Laslo claims he is 'all but immortal'. Wears a massive armor that augments his strength and durability. War Machine stated It hit harder than Iron Man who was in his Model 13 armor at the time.
abilities: Brilliant inventor, being the one who created The Program and the armor used by Black Brigade.

laslo pevely.name: Laslo Pevely
laslo pevely.origin: ===1940s=== thumb|left|178px|Laslo Pevely pre-transformation Laslo Pevely was the victim of a car accident who, for reasons which were never made entirely clear, was injected with the blood of a mad dog by the man who found him, Dr. John Storm. Pevely, who suffered amnesia as a result of the accident, subsequently found himself transformed whenever evil was near into a vampiric creature who would wreak terrible vengeance on the perpetrators. thumb|left|152px|Terror's original appearance On January 30, 1941, the Terror was one of the many Americans in Washington, D.C. to give a gift to President Roosevelt on his 59th birthday. The festivities were marred by a gift from the Life-Like Doll Company: a high ranking military official murdered and shrunk to the size of a doll. The Terror visited the company, exposing it as a front for the Nazi Fifth Column. After shutting down the operation, the Terror received a commendation from the President himself. Turning his attention to organized crime, the Terror broke up a gang of crooks who targeted only small businesses due to their lack of security. Next, the Terror became interested in the events of World War II. He learned of Nazis tricking refugees into slavery in Africa by promising them safe passage to America and brought down the operation, freeing the slaves before returning to America. Back home, the Terror next clashed with Poison, Inc. led by the aged mobster known simply as the "Old One". This group were murderers for hire who poisoned their targets. Capturing the gang, the Old One poisoned himself to avoid capture. In his last recorded solo adventure of the '40s, the Terror stopped the insurance bilking scheme of mobster Bull Murdock and Mr. Z. In 1959, the Terror was considered by Jimmy Woo as a possible member for the Agents of Atlas. (This does not mean he was still active in 1959, but it does show that the FBI thought he might still be active.) ===Modern Age=== In later years, he lost his powers but regained them in time to help the She-Hulk combat a cosmic threat.
weaknesses: Limited Mobility: In the modern age, the Terror is confined to a wheelchair as Pevely.

laughing boy.origin: From early childhood, the man who grew up to be known as Laughing Boy was always sadistic individual who enjoyed the pain and suffering of others. This psychological problem first manifested when still an infant and Laughing Boy witnessed a car accident and began to laugh. As a youth, he pushed a classmate out of a window for his own amusement, and was tattled on by his classmate Susan Dane. Sent to reform school, Laughing Boy eventually beat one of his fellow classmates to death with a hammer. An adult, Laughing Boy was the leader of his own gang by 1947 and operated out of New York City. Reading the newspaper one day he learned of Fred Davis Jr.'s extensive celebrity autograph collection and went to the Lee School to steal it. There he clashed with Captain America and Bucky (Fred's alter ego) but managed to escape with the autograph book. Coincidentally, he spotted Susan Dane (now an actress coming to visit the school) and Betsy Ross arriving. Remembering how she tattled on him as a child, Laughing Boy attacked Susan but was fought off by Betsy and was forced to flee when the police were about to arrive. Over the next few days, Laughing Boy then forged checks of celebrities who were visiting town. When the heat became too strong, Laughing Boy and his gang relocated to Hollywood, California where he renewed his attentions toward Susan Dane. Learning that she was starring in a film about Marie Antoinette and that they studio was using the actual jewels worn by the historical figure, Laughing Boy sought to not only eliminate Susan but stealth the priceless jewels. Kidnapping Susan from her dressing room, Laughing Boy was about to decapitate her with a guillotine when he was interrupted once more by Captain America and Bucky. While Bucky subdued Laughing Boy's gang, Captain America made short work of Laughing Boy and the entire gang was turned over to the police. Laughing Boy's subsequent fate is unknown.
weapons: Laughing Boy had a pistol.
weaknesses: Laughing Boy suffers from , as such he takes pleasure from the pain and misfortune of others.

laura banner.name: Laura Banner
laura banner.origin: Laura Banner was the first wife of Dr. David Banner. Their happy marriage was tragically cut short, when the couple's car crashed. David was thrown out of the car, while Laura was trapped inside, as the car caught fire. David tried to get her out but was too weak to pull the door open. Laura died in the fire. Her death hit David hard and over the next 11 months, he buried himself in work. He knew others, put in similar situations, have accomplished near superhuman feat (like a mother lifting a car, to save her trapped son). This obsession eventually led to David's transformation, into the Hulk.

laura brown lmd.name: Laura Brown (LMD)
laura brown lmd.origin: This Life Model Decoy of S.H.I.E.L.D. agent Laura Brown was created by the Encoders under the control of the Deltite, an advanced LMD created by Arnim Zola who had replaced several S.H.I.E.L.D. operatives, including the Executive Board, with LMDs. Laura Brown was put in charge of Project: Delta at Roxxon's Power Plant in New Jersey. She ordered the Encoders to create an LMD of Kate Neville. Laura gathered the heads of , , , Imperial Chemical industries, and other major corporations at Roxxon House in Rocky Mountains. They declared their plans to dismantle the economic order and filled the room with gas knocking everyone out. She turned them over to the Encoders to be replaced with LMDs. Later Laura showed the Encoders images of the Clay Quartermain LMD and were amazed by it's capabilities. As they toured Project Delta at Roxxon she was interrupted by Valentina Allegra de Fontaine, who wanted to know what she was doing, but Laura refused to provide any. Laura then gathered various S.H.I.E.L.D. agents and planed to encode them as well. on the S.H.I.E.L.D. satellite. The Dellite hoped to extract the Infinity Formula for Nick Fury. Laura brought Alexander Pierce, Al Mackenzie, and Madame Hydra to the prison were they kept the other waiting for encoding. Madame Hydra however lead an uprising leading the prisoners against the Deltite Agent. Laura was destroyed along with the other trapped on the S.H.I.E.L.D. Space Station when the power core exploded.

laura dean.name: Laura Dean
laura dean.origin: ===Early Life=== Laura Dean's parents were extremely mutaphobic Canadians who decided to have Laura's twin fetus aborted because she displayed physical mutations. While still a fetus, Laura protected her twin sister by using her mutant power to open portals to other dimensions and sent her to the realm that would later be called Liveworld. After her birth, Laura was diagnosed autistic and was withdrawn from the world. In an attempt to cure her autism, her parents sent her to the New Life Clinic, which was actually run by the insane villain Scramble. ===Derangers=== Laura managed to escape but was later caught by Bedlam and forced to become a member of his team of Derangers. During the clash with Alpha Flight, Laura swapped places with her twin in Liveworld, whom she had dubbed Goblyn. ===Alpha & Beta=== After Alpha Flight defeated Bedlam, Goblyn and Laura were admitted into Beta Flight under the disbelief that they were one and the same person. However, this was all sorted out when Alpha Flight travelled to Liveworld and there encountered the Dreamqueen. When they returned to Earth, and Alpha disbanded, Laura and Goblyn went to live with the Purple Girl. They re-joined Beta Flight when Talisman dispatched them on a quest for Northstar, thanks to Laura`s ability to open portals to other dimensions. The two stayed on when the team was once again funded by the government and Department H was re-formed. However, both were severely injured when Wild Child went insane and attacked them. Laura sent Goblyn instinctively to Liveworld and had to return with Beta Flight to save her. Since the disbanding of Alpha Flight after the clash with the Hardliners, resulting in the subsequent disbanding of Beta Flight, Pathway's whereabouts are unknown.

laura dunham.name: Laura Dunham
laura dunham.origin: Laura Dunham is Richard Rider aka Nova's former girlfriend. She and Nova were involved in a fender bender and exchanged numbers. Laura's family were affluent, which made Richard uncomfortable about the prospect of meeting them during the holidays. Laura once invited Rich to her family's ski cabin in Vermont. Nova briefly suspected Laura of being Tailhook, a vigilante killing college rapists. Although she wasn't, Laura did help Tailhook escape capture, which led to a rift between Rich and Laura. Once Namorita returned to the New Warriors after a sabbatical, she and Rich confessed their feelings for each other and Rich stopped dating Laura. Laura stayed friends with Nova after their breakup. She called the New Warriors to warn them that Rich was going to try to jump off a bridge in an attempt to reactivate his powers.

laura goldstein.name: Laura Goldstein
laura goldstein.origin: Laura Jay was the wife of Victor Jay, a vigilante of the 1940s known as Mister E. When he disappeared during World War II, Laura waited for him for a few years before moving on and taking up Victor's original Jewish surname, Goldstein. When Victor woke up in the modern era, he sought out his family. When he found them, Laura was very aged and bedridden. Upon seeing Laura, Victor broke down in tears and kneeled in front of her bed saying he was sorry, though she was sleeping. Laura died shortly afterwards, and Victor attended her funeral. After everybody had left, he spoke to her coffin and further expressed his remorse.

laura porter.name: Laura Porter
laura porter.origin: Wealthy John Porter tells his sister Laura that he is terminally ill and reveals that he has developed a powerful biological weapon. Using a plane they dust their farm with the weapon, killing all the cattle on the the land, proving the weapon works, unaware that they are being watched by Japanese spies. A week later, while on his death bed, John tells his sister to bury the formula with him in secrecy and promises to only remove it should the Allies need help in the war. Laura agrees. Months after John's death, strange walking dead are sighted walking around the cemetery at night, frightening the locals. They deduce that these "zombies" must be looking for something, and along with the undertaker Peter Anzel and the constable they go up to the graveyard to investigate. Seeing the apparent walking dead, the people flee the scene vowing never to return to the grave yard again. When the story reaches the newspaper, it is read by William Nasland and Fred Davis Jr. that recall John Porter's chemical research and decide to go an investigate as Captain America and Bucky. Rushing to the graveyard, they spot men searching around and attack them in a mausoleum. However, one of the men gets away and when the pair chase after him they spot a girl running through the graveyard. Recognizing her as Laura they catch up to her and she explains that the formula is hidden with her brother's body, but refuses to tell the two heroes where it is hidden and runs off into the night. Following after her, they spot her entering another mausoleum and suddenly hear her cry for help. Even if she refuses to talk, the Japanese spies just discover a secret panel in the tomb that will lead to the hidden chamber where John's body is buried.

laura russell.name: Laura Russell
laura russell.origin: As a young woman, Laura journeyed to the Transylvanian city of Medias on holiday. There she briefly dated Phillip Russoff, before meeting and falling in love with Phillip's older brother Baron Gregory Russoff. Laura and Gregory were wed and sired their first child, Jacob (and Phillip moved to America). Within a year, Laura gave birth to a daughter named Lissa. When Jacob was only two years old, Laura noticed that her husband had taken on some strange habits. For three nights out of every month, Russoff would seal himself inside of a tower room in his castle with instructions to never be disturbed. He told his young wife that he was studying. One evening however, a lightning storm swept through the Baltic nation and a stray bolt blasted a hole in the side of the tower. That same night, witnesses claimed to have seen a werewolf prowling the countryside. Several of the town elders visited Russoff Castle to inquire with the Baron, but when Laura inspected the tower room, he was nowhere to be found. Still later, a group of hunters, armed with silver bullets cornered the werewolf and shot him. It was then that they discovered that the werewolf was actually the Baron. Following the death of Gregory Russoff, Laura took her children and returned to the United States. The widow of a Baron, Laura had inherited all of her late husband's vast wealth, but she also knew that her children had inherited something more – the curse of the werewolf. Years passed, and Laura settled down in Los Angeles, California. She reunited with her brother-in-law (who had anglicized his name to Philip Russell) and the two fell in love. Laura and Philip married, and she Americanized her son's name to Jack. Laura did not tell her children that their new stepfather was also their uncle. Philip was a stern man, who managed to keep a dominating hold over Laura. For some reason the brakes on her car failed, and Laura's vehicle crashed, injuring her greatly. Emergency crews rushed her to the hospital where she remained in critical condition. The following day, Philip Russell told Jack what had happened. He went to the hospital to visit his dying mother, whereupon he learned of his family heritage. Jack suspected that Philip was involved in the accident, but Laura made him swear that he would not seek revenge against him. After hearing her son’s vow, Laura passed away in her hospital bed. Philip would later claim he was not involved in Laura's death and revealed to Jack and Lissa that he was in fact their father's brother.

lauren sherwood.name: Lauren Sherwood
lauren sherwood.origin: Lauren Sherwood was a babysitter for Eden Blake and her kids, frequently subbing for Eden's mother when "Eden" (secretly the 1500 year old male soldier named Lukasz) went off to battle evil as Mantra. When starting high school, Lauren was small and underdeveloped at first, often the target of ridicule from the other girls. On one occasion, a demon manipulated her desires and transformed her into a duplicate of Mantra, causing havoc in Canoga Park. The real Mantra tracked down the impostor Lauren and put her back in her normal body. As time passed, Lauren grew into an extremely attractive teenage girl, and began dying her hair blond to complete the local "Valley Girl" look. Unfortunately, this did little for her popularity -- Lauren was still mostly shunned by the popular girls, mocked by the boys, and now mistreated by her previous friends for her new "Muffy" makeover. As Eden Blake's babysitter, she was present when the Black September effect somehow gave ten-year-old Gus Blake magical powers to act out his anger issues. While Eden Blake struggled to contain her son, she tricked him into casting Lauren into the pocket realm of Mantra's cape. Eden telepathically guided Lauren to find the mystical armor and weaponry necessary to defend against Gus.
weapons: Sword of Fangs

lauren strucker.name: Lauren Strucker
lauren strucker.origin: Lauren Strucker is a mutant from Atlanta, Georgia. Her powers first manifested during a vacation when the family car veered off the road, and she generated a force field to protect her family. Her brother Andy's mutant powers manifested while he was being bullied at a dance. His powerful telekinetic abilities caused the school to partially collapse. Lauren publicly revealed herself as a mutant when she used her powers to shield herself and others from debris. She found Andy, and after calming him down they went home and came out to their mother Caitlin as mutants. Lauren and Andy used their powers to help the family escape from the Sentinel Services when they came to take them away for the safety of the community. Reed Strucker used his connections at the District Attorney's office to contact Eclipse from the Mutant Underground and arranged for his family to escape to safety across the border in Mexico. The Sentinel Services ambushed the Strucker family when they met Eclipse. Fortunately, Thunderbird and Blink tracked Eclipse and helped them escape. Blink opened a portal to the Underground's headquarters before the Sentinel Services cornered them. Lauren, Andy, Caitlin, and the mutants from the Underground escaped to safety, but Blink could not leave the portal open long enough for Reed to come through after an agent of the Sentinel Services shot him in the leg.

lauren wolfe.name: Lauren Wolfe
lauren wolfe.origin: Lauren Wolfe is one of the superpowered member of the Secret Warriors team formed by Nick Fury. She is a Polymorph or shapeshifter, who was imprisoned at Project P.E.G.A.S.U.S. until being freed by Nick Fury, and given a reduced sentence if she joined the team. She is listed as an untapped superhuman which he could use in her secret war against Hydra and Leviathan. She was assigned to Team Black, where all of the more problematic Caterpillars were sent, which was led by Alexander Pierce. ===Last Ride of the Howling Commandos=== Team Black was deployed to take part in a joint attack on Hydra's Hell's Heaven base in China along with the Howling Commandos PMC. The mission was succesful with Team Black taking point on the infiltration of the base, allowing for a bomb to be detonated destroying the base. With their mission complete, Team Black made their own separate exit, not realizing that the Commandos would suffer a devastating battle against Hydra forces after they left. ===Wheels Within Wheels=== Having won his secret war against Hydra and Leviathan, Nick Fury pulled together all of the surviving members of the Secret Warriors and Howling Commandos together into a new organization sponsored by the United Nations. Team Black, now served in this organization under the overall command of Quake.
powers: Polymorph: As a polymorph, Lauren Wolfe is capable of shape shifting. She utilizes this ability in combat by forming her hands into maces or other simple weaponry.
abilities: Lauren Wolfe received the same training in and combat as other members of the Secret Warriors.

laurent bavota.name: Laurent Bavota
laurent bavota.origin: When he was younger, Laurent looked up to and dreamed of being part of Alpha Flight, picking the codename Argent for himself. During the Fall of X, Laurent crossed into Ottawa from Gatineau to access the Krakoan Gateways there, but was unable to do so due to Orchis disabling them. Laurent traveled to Toronto only to discover that the Gateways there didn't work either. Laurent lost control of his powers while defending himself from anti-mutant assailants in Saskatoon and Alpha Flight attempted to apprehend him. He was rescued by Aurora, Northstar, Fang and Nemesis and taken to Krakoa North in Manitoba. While there, Laurent learned from Northstar that they were planning on taking mutant refugees off-world to Chandilar and that Alpha Flight was secretly helping them. While given a checkup by Shaman, Laurent was offered a spot on Alpha Flight but he refused, due to being traumatized from the recent events. While residing at Krakoa North, Laurent became increasingly restless and homesick. Disillusioned with the mutant cause, Laurent vented his frustrations to Kyle Jinadu, who was worried that Laurent's agitated state could rile the other refugees and urgently sent a message to Northstar to hasten the evacuation to Chandilar. Laurent eventually got tired of waiting and left Krakoa North during the night. However, Laurent's actions allowed Department H to detect the mutants hiding there. Laurent immediately regretted his decision when he saw Box Sentinels attack Krakoa North. Laurent attempted to rescue his friends and managed to destroy a Sentinel, but was killed by another one commanded by Roger Bochs Jr.. Laruent's death was not in vain, as his sacrifice bought Alpha Flight enough time to rescue all the mutant refugees. Northstar later acquired Laurent's belongings and sent them to Laurent's mother, along with a letter expressing his condolences.
powers: He can transform into liquid metal and back.
abilities: Laurent was fluent in French and English

laurent levessaur.name: Laurent Levessaur
laurent levessaur.origin: Laurent operated Madam Trudeau's Museum De' Wax in Montreal. At some point, a meteor landed in his backyard and he was able to use the "space wax" to craft lifelike sculptures for the museum. He created an exhibit of American heroes that he hoped would teach Canadians the danger of idolizing those heroes. Instead, he wanted Canadians to feel a greater sense of pride in their own nationality. When fledgling Alpha Flight members Puck and Major Mapleleaf visited, they paid respects to the heroes, angering Laurent. He used his control over the wax statues to make them "come to life," replicating the powers of the heroes on which they were based. Puck and Mapleleaf called in the rest of the team and battled the statues - which could duplicate the powers but were far less durable. The conflict was brought to an end when Puck knocked out Laurent. Without his control, the statues froze in place.

lauri ell.name: Lauri-Ell
lauri ell.origin: Lauri-Ell was a soldier artificially bred by scientists of the Kree. She was created from the DNA of two powerful Kree Soldiers, one of which was Mari-Ell. Because of this, Lauri-Ell was the half-sister of Carol Danvers, the half-human, half-Kree super hero called Captain Marvel. A powerful warrior herself, Lauri-Ell was designed to be an excellent soldier. Even though fighting came naturally to Lauri-Ell, she hated waging conflict. thumb|left During the early days of the Kree/Skrull Alliance, Lauri-Ell was stationed in K'in-Al, an experimental sanctuary where citizens of the former enemy empires were to live together in peace. The city's existence was short-lived due to its destruction at the hands of the Kree-hating human Wastrel. Lauri-Ell was the only survivor of the explosion, and the blame for it befell on her. When Captain Marvel, who had become the Alliance's new Accuser, arrived at the scene, Lauri-Ell surrendered and accepted her execution despite claiming to be innocent. Using the Universal Weapon to probe Lauri-Ell's mind, Carol found out her parentage, which Lauri-Ell had avoided disclosing to spare Carol of the guilt of killing her own half-sister. Carol became convinced that Lauri-Ell was innocent, and took her to Earth for her protection until she found the true culprit. On Earth, Lauri-Ell joined forces with Carol to combat invading Cotati forces, allowing the two sisters to bond. Captain Marvel eventually returned to K'in-Al and managed to apprehend Wastrel with the help of her allies. In the meantime, Lauri-Ell had decided to help stop another Cotati attack in which one of the victims was Carol's friend Kit Renner. Lauri-Ell was joined by Carol and her allies. During the fight, Carol was overpowered by Cotati soldiers and lost grip of her Universal Weapon. The hammer called to Lauri-Ell, and she wielded it. Lauri-Ell's perfect harmonization with the hammer signaled her potential to become an Accuser herself. After defeating the Cotati, Lauri-Ell returned the hammer to Carol so she could fulfill her promise to use it to put an end to the Cotati invasion. Following the end of the Cotati's Empyre, Emperor Hulkling of the Alliance appointed Lauri-Ell his new chief Accuser in place of Carol. A few weeks later, Lauri-Ell paid Carol a visit at the Danvers' summer home in Harpswell so she could pay her respects at Mari-Ell's grave. As the Emperor's Accuser, Lauri-Ell accompanied Hulkling and his consort Wiccan in their honeymoon at the Starbeaches. When the symbiote god Knull tried to take over the galaxy, he sent the symbiote-possessed members of an Alliance expedition to kill Hulkling. As the planet was besieged by Symbiote Dragons and the symbiote-possessed crewmates, Lauri-Ell and Wiccan helped Hulkling to conduct a mass evacuation of Little Chandilar's patrons, leading their fleet of ships to safety. After Carol broke up with War Machine, her best friend Spider-Woman saw she fell into depression so she decided to bring Spectrum, Hazmat and Lauri-Ell for a girls' night out. They began the night with speed dating, before snake-cat hybrids and sexy wizards arrived to attack. Carol was dissatisfied with how things turned out and left for a bar in Hell's Kitchen. During Dormammu's invasion of the Throneworld, Lauri-Ell and the Alliance army fended off countless Mindless Ones teleporting there. She informed the Emperor of the situation, and telling him that despite their best efforts, they were slowly being overwhelmed. Thankfully, Dormammu and his forces were later defeated with the help of the Guardians of the Galaxy. Carol and James eventually reformed their relationship and decided to go on a trip together. However, as they were about to depart for Bermuda, Lauri appeared before the couple with the news that the genetic materials of notable Kree warriors, including their mother's, had been mysteriously stolen, and needed Carol's help to find the culprit. She brought them to a Kree laboratory in the Throneworld where they began investigating. The trio went to the lab's sewers where they were confronted by the Sludge, a Kree microorganism designed to eat lab waste. It revealed it had consumed the genetic materials when it took the form of Mar-Vell. It then attempted to infect Lauri's Weapon and James' armor, leaving Carol to disintegrate it. With the mystery solved, they were forced to remain in quarantine for at least three days before they could resume their regular activities. Lauri was later contacted by her sister as she was being attacked by a group of people controlled by Vox Supreme. She teleported to her location, where Carol handed Lauri an incapacitated Ms. Marvel and instructed her bring the young heroine to Tony Stark and keep her safe. Carol managed to free her friends from Vox's control on New Hala, but as they were being overwhelmed by the Super-Inhuman's other forces Lauri, along with Ms. Marvel, the Avengers and the Guardians arrived to her aid. During the ensuing battle, Lauri

laurie lynton.name: Laurie Lynton
laurie lynton.origin: thumb|left Laurie Lynton was an overweight girl who had a crush on Peter Parker while they were students at Midtown high school. She almost beat Peter in the science fair, at the same time they received their prizes and stood together, Flash Thompson mocked them by saying that their standing together is the only time two nerds made a 10. Laurie was deeply hurt by Flash's words and may have wolfed a half dozen candy bars before bedtime. After graduating, she left the town, went to Northern California, and got a degree in engineering. Laurie also changed her diet and tried her best to stay in shape and decided that she really wanted to work in journalism and started to do the science column. laurie simpson neal.name: Laurie Simpson Neal
laurie simpson neal.origin: Laurie Simpson Neal was the wife of lighthouse keeper Franklin Neal and the mother of young Angelica Neal. The Neals had a troubled marriage, owing largely to Frank's decision to take up the position of lighthouse keeper of Harrow's Point after the untimely death of the previous keeper. Laurie did not support the decision and resented the fact that Frank uprooted them from their home and relocated them to Maine. She wanted Frank to accept a position working at her father's bank, but Frank refused. Within an evening of moving into the lighthouse, Laurie discovered that her daughter had fallen prey to a vampire. The local physician, Doctor Chowder, administered a blood transfusion with Laurie as the donor and saved Angelica's life. That same evening, Dracula insinuated his way into the Neal home. Unable to finish off Angelica (due to some well-placed crucifixes and garlic), he instead sated his thirst on Laurie. The substantial blood loss, both from the attack and the transfusion, proved too much for Laurie and she died soon after. Three nights later, she awakened in her coffin as a vampire. Her husband Frank as well as Doctor Chowder and the local bishop Father McFarland restrained her in her coffin while Frank drove a stake into her heart.
powers: Had Laurie continued to exist, she would have developed all of the powers of a traditional vampire. However, she was destroyed before her proficiency in such abilities could ever be demonstrated.

laussa odinsdottir.name: Laussa Odinsdottir
laussa odinsdottir.species: Asgardian (daughter of Aesir and Vanir)Fire Demon hybrid
laussa odinsdottir.origin: Conceived in the aftermath of the War of Burning, Laussa was intended to fulfill the pact that had ended the Aesir/Vanir War. She was the first child of both royal bloodlines to be considered legitimate, as elder sister Aldrif was long believed dead. Unbeknownst to her parents, Surtur's essence lingered in the realm in which Laussa was conceived, making the lord of Muspelheim her third parent. ===Kidnapped by Angela=== After Laussa was kidnapped at birth by her older sister Angela, who recently discovered her true heritage as the thought-dead Aldrif, a group of Asgardians led by the Odinson followed them to Limbo, and tried to rescue the child. However, Angela's partner, and love, Sera teleported them away from there to Midgard. Thanks to Heimdall, the Asgardians were able to discover Angela's whereabouts and used the Bifrost to get there. They tried to rescue the girl yet again, but Sera teleported them away once more, this time to Vanaheim. Once they dealt with a group of Dark Elves, Angela, Sera, and the baby went to the Temple of Union, a place in Vanaheim that symbolized not only the end of the Aesir/Vanir War but everlasting love as well. There, Angela acquired Siri's wedding dress, the one thing Heimdall couldn't see through. With its abilities, Angela took Sera and the baby to the Moon, where the Guardians of the Galaxy were waiting for them. thumb|left|In demon form Following a fierce battle against the Dísir, the Guardians discovered the truth about the baby Angela was carrying and demanded answers. Angela explained that Odin and Freyja laid together in the space between realms, the same place to where Odin had purged Surtur's essence, thus making him the child's third parent. Angela needed to take the child to Heven so they could save everything from burning, but the Guardians didn't believe her until the baby transformed herself into a fire demon and burned Groot down. The Guardians took Angela and the baby to Heven, where Angela would use the city's furnace to siphon Surtur's power out of her. There they were attacked by its inhabitants, the Angels, and the Asgardians, who had discovered Angela's location thanks to the Dísir. Angela was attacked by an enraged Odinson and a battle ensued between them over the fate of their sister. The baby nearly died in the battle, as a pillar almost fell on her, but Angela used her own body to protect her sister from harm. Seeing Angela didn't want to hurt their sister, Odinson helped her get above the city's furnace, and then Angela threw her sister into it. The furnace siphoned Surtur's power from within her, powering the city of Heven for the rest of its existence. As the furnace started to burn her skin, Angela approached her and enveloped her inside the part of Siri's wedding dress that formed her wings. They both went out of the city's furnace through a door on its base. The girl was taken by Odinson to his mother, who then commanded her Asgardian army to retreat to Asgardia. After taking both Angela and Sera prisoners for what they had done, All-Mother Freyja told Angela her sister's name: Laussa. As Odin and Freyja discussed if they would or not free Angela and Sera, Laussa's eyes brightened like blazing brimstone and she was exhaling black smoke as she breathed, proving that Surtur's power was still growing inside her. ===War of the Realms=== When the War of the Realms came to Midgard, Laussa was targeted by her "sister" Sindr. Freyja tasked Laussa's brother Balder with the baby's protection, and he gathered a group of heroes for assistance that would become Laussa's "Babysitters Club." The baby's godly and royal instincts prompted her to gather an army to fight in the War of the Realms, and she instinctively used her latent powers to influence her guardians into visiting specific destinations where they could gather allies she would then influence too. thumb|left|Laussa and her "Babysitters Club" The first of these locations was Bide-a-Wee RV Campground, a caravan park inhabited by Skrull deserters. The next one was an abandoned Wild West-inspired theme park named Six Gun Territory, where the babysitters encountered the ghosts of heroes from that time period, summoned by the Demon Rider, who was in turn acting on behalf of Laussa. The babysitters then stopped by Sterling Hotel & Casino, which was hosting a convention for super villain henchmen. At the hotel, the babysitters were reached by Ares, who had agreed to find the baby for Sindr, and was guided to the heroes by the Demon Rider impersonating her. Ares managed to abduct Laussa, but her babysitters retrieved her and confronted Ares. During the fight, the Demon Rider arrived with an army of the people from the locations the heroes had visited, and revealed that she had facilitated Ares' mission at Laussa's own request so that she could influence Ares into fighting for the Earth as well. After Ares accepted to follow the child's will, the babysitters reactivated a S.H.I.E.L.D. Helicarrier hidden i

While Lavita would get her hands dirty, she kept her contact with illegal activities at a remove. Married to a husband, Lavita wanted a lot more. Eventually, her boss gave her a gambling room that she would oversee, only to discover that it was coup and an Irish crimelord Tommy Horgan, along with his henchman, beat her up. In revenge, she killed Horgan by burying his feet in cement and drowning him.

lawholder.name: Lawholder
lawholder.origin: While in the clutches of members of the Zodiac Cartel, Nick Fury finds himself drawn to the Zodiac Key. Activating it, he transports himself, the three members of the Zodiac Cartel, Spymaster, Daredevil, Iron Man and Madame Masque to the realm of the Ankh, and put before the Lawholder of the Brotherhood of the Ankh. The Lawholder explains to them that he comes from an order that worships the balance between order and chaos, and that they had created the Zodiac Key for that purpose. He then has all present fight each other, and soon Daredevil is battling Capricorn, Iron Man battles Spymaster, Madame Masque battles Aquarius, and Nick Fury battles Sagittarius. However, the members of the priesthood begin to notice that Daredevil's heart is not in the battle, and so the Lawholder uses the Zodiac Key to send them all back to Earth.

lawrence chesney.name: Lawrence Chesney
lawrence chesney.origin: Lawrence Chesney was the son of an unnamed father who worked as a model for the covers of 1930s vigilante Copperhead. As his father aged he slowly began to go insane once the book's were cancelled and began to believe he was Copperhead. He remained bitter about profits he believed he was owed till his death. Chesney learned that the Copperhead stories were going to be reprinted and decided to take on the Copperhead identity and killed the author, Walter Kranz. He then took on more of the Copperhead's identity and killed several minor criminals including Chester Chino. This attracted the attention of Daredevil who found and battled him but the Copperhead overwhelmed him and escaped. His next victim was Milton Wexler who was the book's original publisher. He then set out to the books new publisher, Martin Foster but was again confronted by Daredevil and was able to overwhelm him. Copperhead left and visited his father's grave and was tracked down by Daredevil and the pair fought, this time however, Copperhead was seemingly killed when he copper armor was struck by lightning. After dying, his soul fell into the possession of an unnamed demon and was returned to Earth to obtain the soul of Spider-Man. To this end, he set about creating the Gang of Four and launched a plot to conquer the Kingpin's criminal empire, to attract the attention of both Spider-Man and Daredevil. As expected the pair tracked to the gang to their hideout and attacked them. During the battle Copperhead revealed his true nature and captured his teammates in mystic torture and attempted to claim the souls of all present. However, the Owl saved Daredevil and the entire Gang was pulled into the portal. The current fate of Copperhead is unknown, but the members have all returned without any harm.
weapons: Pneumatic pistol that can fire tranquilizer darts or snake venom

lawrence evans.name: Lawrence Evans
lawrence evans.origin: Lawrence Evans stole an armored battlesuit from parties unknown. Taking the name Bolt, Evans broke into a bank late at night. After neutralizing the guards and grabbing a bag of cash, he ran right into Daredevil. After a brief battle, Daredevil jammed his billy club into a chink in Bolt's armor, knocking Evans out. Waking up several minutes later tied to a pole, Evans was interrogated by Daredevil. Although he refused to divulge who he had stolen the armor from, as they would kill him if they knew he had taken it, Evans did tell Daredevil that he had heard Vincente Fortunato was planning to execute Spider-Man that night. Thanking Larry and promising to have his "lawyer friend" Matt Murdock call him, Daredevil swung away to rescue the wall-crawler.

lawrence lazek.name: Lawrence Lazek
lawrence lazek.origin: Lawrence Lazek is a billionaire businessman who was primarily associated with the creation of a black-market version of the Super-Soldier Serum. He is the public face and architect behind the unethical experiments that led to the "new and improved" serum manufactured by Alchemax. He claimed to have perfected a "Hyperkinetic" power set, which he intended to sell to the highest bidder for $10 billion per dose. To refine this serum, his operations involved poisoning the water supply of a local community and kidnapping unhoused teenagers to serve as test subjects. His experiments were directly responsible for the transformation of Aaron Fischer.

He claimed to have perfected a "Hyperkinetic" power set, which he intended to sell to the highest bidder for $10 billion per dose. To refine this serum, his operations involved poisoning the water supply of a local community and kidnapping unhoused teenagers to serve as test subjects. His experiments were directly responsible for the transformation of Aaron Fischer.

lawrence rambow.name: Lawrence Rambow
lawrence rambow.origin: thumb|left|Human form Lawrence Rambow was the son of scientist Phillip Zoltan Rambow who once worked with Reed Richards, who later became Mister Fantastic, leader of the Fantastic Four. Years later, Phillip was working on a device that could neutralize any weapon. Assisting him on this noble goal was his son. During the experiment something went wrong and Lawrence was bombarded with and transformed by a strange energy. This energy form then went on a rampage across New York City. Not wishing his son to be harmed, Phillip sought out his old colleague, but instead ran into his wife the Invisible Girl, who was fending off the creature during its attack. She was soon joined by her teammates, Mister Fantastic and the Human Torch. Realizing that a neutralizer device in his lab could revert his son back to normal, Rambow was taken there by the Human Torch while Mr. Fantastic and the Invisible Girl kept Lawrence at bay. Getting the neutralizer in on time, Phillip activated it, changing his son back to normal. Following the battle Rambow had to be hospitalized, his subsequent fate is unknown.

lawrence schrott.name: Lawrence Schrott
lawrence schrott.origin: The Ape lived up to his namesake due to his ape like appearance and the fact that he was covered with hair. He became a famous boxer in the 1940's, eventually being billed as the "most hideous fighter in America". His strength and ruthlessness in the ring attracted the attention of both mobster Big Joe, and costumed hero the Challenger. After one particular match, the Challenger (in his civilian guise of Bill Waring) kept a watchful eye on the Ape after spotting some of Big Joe's men at the match. These hired thugs had come to hire the Ape for $100,000 to help in a bank heist. Having no morals to speak of the Ape gladly took the job. However when the bank heist was pulled off, the Ape was left behind while Big Joe and his men made their getaway. The Ape became furious and fought his way through security and the police, although a bullet struck his head to get away. Surviving the shot, the bullet lodged in the Ape's thick skull began causing him to fill with a murderous rage and he sought to get revenge against Big Joe for deserting him. Unknown to the Ape, the Challenger followed him back to Big Joe's hideout. The Challenger crashed in, but failed to stop the Ape from murdering Big Joe and his men before escaping. Now becoming homicidally insane, the Ape killed a shop keeper in order to get some food. Tracking the Ape, the Challenger battled the massive man again. During the fight, the Challenger struck the Ape right where the bullet had struck him earlier. This strike caused the Ape a great deal of pain and took the fight out of him. With the Ape defeated he was handed over to the authorities. His fate remains unrevealed.

lawrence young.origin: Lawrence Young was a S.H.I.E.L.D agent whose body was eventually stolen by his former colleague Jack Truman, whose mind had previously been trapped in a prototype Deathlok robot. Truman used a technique he had learned to shift his psyche into Young's body while displacing Young into the Deathlok body, leaving him trapped in the cyborg body while Truman enjoyed a normal human life. ===After Civil War=== After the Civil War, he was listed as a potential recruit for the Initiative. However, some time later, Truman noted that without access to maintenance, Young's Deathlok body was unlikely to function for long. Young was last seen either dead or immobilized in a scrap yard.

lawrence zaxton.name: Lawrence Zaxton
lawrence zaxton.origin: Professor Lawrence Zaxton was a jealous colleague of Dr. Donald Blake. When Blake built an android and asked Zaxton to display it at a convention, Zaxton deliberately caused the android to malfunction. Thor removed the android from the scene before it detonated. Zaxton then kidnapped Blake's nurse Jane Foster and blackmailed Blake into helping him perfect his Duplicator machine. When their work was complete, Blake attempted to become Thor and sneak away, but Professor Zaxton witnessed his transformation and used his device to make an evil Demon Duplicate of Thor. He armed the duplicate with two copies of Thor's hammer Mjolnir, and set it after him. thumb|left|Lawrence and his duplicate However, Thor eventually realized that because the duplicate was not worthy of the power of Mjolnir, it could not actually harm him, and he destroyed it. As Thor set after Professor Zaxton as he escaped, he fumbled with his device and fell off a bridge trying to catch them. Thor let Zaxton's good duplicate carry on with the professor's life.
abilities: Professor Zaxton was a brilliant inventor.

laz.name: Laz
laz.origin: Laz was a Skrull who was attempting to invade Earth, along with two other Skrulls. While pretending to be humans, the Skrulls allowed the hitchhiking Rocket Raccoon and Groot on their starship, before Laz accidentally morphed into the form of Groot, followed by a Rocket-Groot hybrid, blowing their cover. Groot and Rocket escaped using an escape pod. Mistaking it as Earth, Laz and his two Skrull allies attacked the intergalactic fueling station Earfk where they were defeated by Groot and Mantron and their ship destroyed. Left with no direction, the three joined Groot in his mission to save Rocket Raccoon from the bounty hunter Eris. During the ensuing battle, Laz revealed that he was a Super-Skrull though he had no idea what that even meant.
powers: and Super-Skrull Powers
weaknesses: Laz appeared to have little control over his shape shifting, sometimes changing accidentally.

laza lanti.name: Laza-Lanti
laza lanti.origin: ===Origin and youth in Dark Valley=== Laza-Lanti was one of the twin sons born in Dark Valley (in Koth and near the Zamorian border), from the Demon of Dark Valley's union with the mortal dancer Timara. The night he was born, a midwife saw something trying to enter her home, was terrified by what she saw outside, and never spoke again. The other son, Tsotha-Lanti, was sent away with Druids. Laza-Lanti lived with his mother, though he didn't knew his father. When about ten, Laza-Lanti found the midwife dying, and before passing away, she told him "you who were born in Dark Valley, beware the Valley's Lord". Laza-Lanti sensed in the midwife's words and eyes that the Lord of Dark Valley was his father. Laza-Lanti explored the Valley with difficulties, and finally saw two eyes, burning like hellfire, in the shadows, and then fled the Dark Valley, while Timara went to join the Demon. Laza-Lanti became a minstrel, and wrote a song about his adventure in Dark Valley. ===Zamora=== Ten years later, as he was playing in a tavern in Shadizar the Wicked, in Zamora, he met Conan who seemingly appreciated his music, and assaulted the drunkards mocking Laza-Lanti. As one of them drew his sword and sneaked behind the Cimmerian, Laza-Lanti killed him with a knife thrown at his back. The pair were then arrested by the guards of the city, but Laza-Lanti managed to have them freed, using a knife hidden in his lute to threaten the jailer. ===Return to Dark Valley=== For three days, they traveled to Dark Valley, entering Koth. At his arrival, they encountered Laza-Lanti's fellows such as Fezal, who were preparing the sacrificial cattle destined for the Lord of Dark Valley, and welcomed Laza-Lanti with fear and hate, associating him with the Demon-Lord. Laza-Lanti and Conan hid at the approach of a young woman (in fact Timara) who came to lead the cattle to a cave beneath the ruins of Dagoth Hill, then followed her. At that time, Laza-Lanti thought he had already seen the woman, perhaps in dreams. Discovering the Demon of Dark Valley, Laza-Lanti bursted to attack the monster, forcing Conan to follow him. As Conan was about to be killed, Laza-Lanti, led by some instinct, worked his way above and behind the creature, grasped his antennae and cut them, killing it. Timara revealed the truth to Laza-Lanti, then committed suicide while laying on the carcass of her lover. Shocked, Laza-Lanti remained silent, then violently demanded that Conan must leave, threatening him. Once Conan gone, Laza-Lanti committed suicide in his turn. ==Religion== Laza-Lanti invoked Mitra to have mercy on his soul.
abilities: Laza-Lanti was a skilled and lute player. He knew how to throw knives, and battled with both sword and knife at the same time.
weapons: Sword and knife.

fields.notes: Tsotha-Lanti, Laza's brother, was created by Robert E. Howard in the Conan short story The Scarlet Citadel (January, 1933), adapted in (June, 1978). In the short story, the sorcerer Pelias (Tsotha-Lanti's archenemy) mentions his foe's origin: "As for Tsotha—men say that a dancing-girl of Shadizar slept too near the pre-human ruins on Dagoth Hill and woke in the grip of a black demon; from that unholy union was spawned an accursed hybrid men call Tsotha-lanti—". The fleshed-out Demon of Dark Valley (inspired by the "black demon" of "The Scarlet Citadel") and the original character and Laza-Lanti's brother Tsotha-Lanti were introduced in (December, 1974).
fields.trivia: and mentions Conan as the killer of the Demon of Dark Valley, when it was Laza-Lanti who killed it.

lazarus ganglion.name: Lazarus Ganglion
lazarus ganglion.origin: Lazarus Ganglion was a mutant filming a documentary about his own ability to circumvent death, and as such he was always followed around by a cameraman. He enlisted Cable to supply a suitable "finale" for the documentary, involving Cable blasting Lazarus to atoms and Lazarus regenerating. powers: Lazarus had the ability to regenerate from any wound, thanks to what Richard, a mercenary working for Jackie Singapore, described as a "decentralized nervous system," meaning he had "backup" brains.

le bull.name: Le Bull
le bull.origin: Le Bull was a French soldier who became loyal to the Nazis following the occupation of France. In the summer of 1942, he and some of his fellow Nazi sympathizers were ordered to smuggle themselves into the United States in order to steal Professor Clement Mott's Cosmic Depressor device for the Nazis. Upon their arrival in Murky Swamp near the professor's home, Le Bull and his men briefly clashed with Captain America who was searching for his sidekick Bucky who was lost in the quicksand surrounding the area. Le Bull and his men managed to escape from Cap and find the location of the Professor's home. Breaking in, they demanded that the Professor turn over his device. However, by this time, the Professor had completely snapped and resolved to save the human race from itself and end the war by using his Cosmic Depressor to wipe out the entire planet Earth. Trapping Le Bull in his men in an electrical field, he forced them to wait until the world was destroyed by his device. Soon, Captain America was also captured. As the zero hour approached, Bucky (alive and well) burst in and attempted to shut down the device; however, he mistakenly freed Le Bull instead. Fighting off Le Bull, he knocked the Nazi operative into the switch that controlled the Cosmic Depressor, shutting it down and freeing Captain America in the process. Chasing back out into the swamp, Le Bull had the unfortunate luck of getting caught in the quicksand and sinking to the bottom.

le loup.origin: Le Loup was a French criminal mastermind whom Solomon Kane spent several years tracking down to avenge the murder of a dying girl he found, and her whole village. After all members of his gang were slain by the puritan, Le Loup managed to escape to Africa, where he became the blood brother of chieftain Songa. Kane eventually tracked him down to Africa, where, with the help of ju-ju man N'longa, he managed to serve justice and kill Le Loup in a duel.

le loup qui petrifies.origin: Le Loup Qui Pétrifies was a wolf allegedly born in the 19th century that got bitten by a cursed human and was remade as the Night Wolf: sometimes being a "normal guy, sometimes a full wolf guy". At some point, he became the leader of the Honor Guard of the Monster King of Staten Island. After returning from one of their missions, they discovered Deadpool had killed their king and become the new monarch according to ancient Monster Law. Although understandably hesitant at first, the entire team eventually accepted Deadpool as their new leader and helped him defeat Kraven the Hunter as he hunted for him. Night Wolf has since been helping Deadpool in all things monster-related and is often left in charge whenever Deadpool leaves the island.

He was present when one of his fellow teammates, Anaïs was knocked unconscious by Cable and his group X-Force. Le Necrogateur used his telepathic abilities of reading the mind of Anaïs's "dead" body not knowing that Cable used a suspended animation bullet to fake it in order to capture him. thumb|left|Visual of Antonio's memories After Fantomex took out the rest of the Le Bureau Discret, they body-slid back to base so Necrogateur could read the mind of the dead mutant, Antonio Aggasiz in hopes of getting information out of him about Volga. powers: Necropathy: Le Necrogateur has the telepathic ability to extract and read the minds of the deceased. He can also project those thoughts visually so others could see them.

fields.notes: Le Sabre Kid is presumably French but was never outright stated to be so. Le Sabre Kid bares some resemblance to Le' Sabre, both with similar names, preference for swords, affiliation with the Pike brothers (Le Sabre Kid working for Cristo Pike and Le' Sabre being a member of Cisco Pike's Gang), and both being created by Ron Zimmerman. le vent.name: Le Vent
le vent.origin: Le Vent was the fastest man in all of Europe and a member of Les Heroes de Paris. He received his power from a sorcerer, who cursed him so that he could never slow down to normal speed. When going up against the villain L'Empereur du Monde Souterrain, who has assembled an army of rock creatures, le Vent used his super-speed to hurl the Thing directly at l'Empereur's tunneler, where the ranting villain declared that the city above, which gave him nothing but pain, deserved to be destroyed for the hurt it had caused him. At some point, Les Héros de Paris vanished, leaving Paris low on super heroes and vulnerable.
powers: Le Vent was said to be able to outrace a plane flying at Mach 4.
weaknesses: Le Vent could never slow down to normal speed.

lea c farr.name: Lea C. Farr
lea c farr.origin: Night was a common criminal until she was found by Mr. Jip and given powers by him. Mr. Jip desired Cloak to be the vessel for his essence and so sent Night and her partner Day (also given powers by Mr. Jip) to try to separate him from Dagger so that he could more easily possess him. Initially successful Dagger came back in the nick of time to stop Mr. Jip's plan. Although unable to acquire Cloak's form, Mr. Jip was able to plant a post-hypnotic suggestion in him that made Cloak take Dagger to an ambush by Night. Using her ability to manipulate inner darkness, Night was able to turn Dagger evil. Cloak managed to turn her back to good, but not before an encounter with X-Factor left her blind. Night assisted Mr. Jip in another scheme to gain control of Cloak that ended in failure.

lea thompson.name: Lea Thompson
lea thompson.origin: Lea Thompson was a veteran actress who had been kidnapped several occasions throughout her life for a limited period of time by Mojo in order to portray Beverly Switzler in a sitcom based on the life of Howard the Duck. After filming whichever Mojo wanted to, Lea was returned to her normal life with no memory of her time abducted. Following several years of experiencing what she believed to be sporadic memory blackouts, Lea began to vaguely recall her experiences, mostly the presence of a talking duck. With this information, she traveled to Brooklyn and sought the help of Howard the Duck himself. With her only clue in hand being a photo of a baby dressed as Professor X, Lea, Howard and his assistant Tara Tam went to a superhero-themed baby photo studio. They snuck past the shop's reception and discovered a TV studio set hidden deep inside the building. The presence of the set caused Lea's memories to come back to her, and Mojo appeared to explain the truth behind it. While most of the program was a reality show that followed Howard, Lea and several other actors were used to film the TV series which acted as a fill-in during the stretches of Howard's life when little happened. The talking duck she recalled was the show's co-star and the actor who portrayed Howard, Z'ien. Fueled by rage over this revelation, Lea attacked Mojo, kicking off a fight between her allies and Mojo's goons. He-lix was teleported to the scene to subdue Lea, teleport her back to her home and erase her memories again. However, as soon as they appeared in her yard, Lea knocked out He-lix and returned safely to her home.

leander natchios.name: Leander Natchios
leander natchios.origin: Leander overtook his cousin Dimitris' business when it was steadily on its way to becoming bankrupt. Pretending to be thoughtful and caring only for the businesses' best interests, Leander was actually using the business as a profit machine for the Kingpin. Elektra found out about the debt which Leander was passing onto Dimitris and sought to pay the money back herself. Leander offered Elektra a one time job in exchange for the release of Dimitri's debt. Elektra accepted. Leander wanted Elektra to pose as a prostitute and sneak into the apartment of an ex-accountant who had written a book containing all the names of the Kingpin's assailants. Kingpin was growing increasingly nervous and handed the responsibility of destroying the docket to Leander. Elektra did manage to get the ledger but was beaten by Poindexter (Ultimate Bullseye) who had been sent by the Kingpin, killed the accountant and stole the ledger, as he did not trust Leander to do the job alone. Poindexter retrieved the ledger whilst Elektra hid, after a fight the two departed alive. Leander had seemingly failed the mission. With the ledger now destroyed and the accountant dead a murder was left unsolved. Police were informed by Poindexter that Elektra had entered a building covered in blood. The police went to Elektra's apartment but after hugging Elektra Dimitris was covered in blood. Informing Elektra and Irene to hide in the house Dimitris was arrested. Poindexter was truly responsible. Elektra wanted revenge and with the help of Daredevil she managed to raid Leander's workhouse and interrogated him. After receiving answers from Leander Elektra was able to retrieve a photocopied version of the ledger which a law firm had produced. Poindexter was also after this document; However this time Elektra won the fight. Elektra made her way to the Kingpin and offered him a deal, she would hand him the ledger if he would allow her Dad to leave prison with a clear record and replace him with the Killer and the thugs who caused this. Kingpin called upon Poindexter and asked him to fight Elektra to see who deserved to be in prison. Elektra used chemicals from her father's business to poison Poindexter and won the fight. As a result Leander and Paul were sent to prison for the murder of the accountant.

lee bradford.name: Lee Bradford
lee bradford.origin: Lee Bradford was captain of the Sky-Sharks, a group of fighter pilots that fought for the Allies during World War II. His reputation had earned him the nickname "Captain Daring". By the winter of 1943, he had learned that Lieutenant Raeger was working for the Nazis and was responsible for the capture of Colonel Welling by the Nazis. When he attempted to apprehend Raeger in a Southhampton tea shop, he was ironically stopped by the colonel's daughter Valerie, who mistook Daring's exploits as empty bragging rather than heroic exploits. However, after Raeger escaped, she soon learned her mistake. Despite the misunderstanding, Daring vowed to rescue her father. To this end, Daring and his fellow Sky-Shark Zeke Mallon participated in a prisoner exchange in Berlin, going there to exchange the Nazi agent Marshall von Hapz for Colonel Welling. However, this turned out to be nothing more than a double cross, and both Daring and Zeke were captured and locked up with Welling. To their surprise, they were assisted in escaping by Raeger, whom they learned was really a double agent working for the allies. During their escape, Raeger was fatally shot, and Daring promised to tell of his bravery upon his return to England. Escaping to the airfield where their plane was kept, Daring and the others were held back by Nazi forces until a surprise attack by the other Sky-Sharks cleared the path. Daring returned to Southampton along with Zeke and Welling and with Von Hapz once more their prisoner. Upon his return to Southampton, Daring was thanked by Valerie for saving her father with a kiss. thumb|right ===Valhalla Villas=== Lee Bradford later appeared as a resident of Valhalla Villas, a retirement home for ex-heroes and ex-villains located in Miami. He was among the residents that were temporarily de-aged by Mary Morgan, who used an unnamed Asgardian artifact during a world-ending event known as an incursion.
abilities: Captain Daring is a skilled fighter pilot.

lee camino.name: Lee Camino
lee camino.origin: Lee Camino was the owner of Sterling Motors, a car company that had decided to pursue an aggressive market strategy. To do so, he obtained financing from Executive Services, Inc., a company that lent money to industrialists, expecting a percentage of the profits. Camino's clause consisted of having to hand over his son Danny to ESI and his death at the hands of Headhunter. Camino didn't take this clause seriously, but when he became insolvent, his son Danny was kidnapped. Spider-Man helped Camino, preventing Headhunter from killing him and thus saving his son Danny, who was being held prisoner by Headhunter in the ESI vaults. Headhunter set traps in the ESI vaults, but Spider-Man overcame the traps and knocked Headhunter out with a punch, revealing all the heads Headhunter had decapitated, stored in glass jars. Headhunter was arrested, while the ESI executives fled in a helicopter, dismissing the incident as a simple setback. Once the ESI crisis was over, Camino began to adopt a softer business policy, putting family first.

lee franks.name: Lee Franks
lee franks.origin: Lee Franks was a mutant operative of Black Air in England. Nicknamed Scratch, he long held enmity for Peter Wisdom before his involvement with Excalibur in his turnaround with the team. Scratch was despised by Peter Wisdom for his indifference for human life and sadism through the intelligence ranks for sociopathic behavior. In later years, Scratch became Black Air's liaison to the Hellfire Club. In exchange for some files, he recovered a mystical codex from Sebastian Shaw to release a demon consecrated in London's underground sewer lines. The British faction of the Hellfire Club intended to harness the demon as a weapon. Scratch successfully abducted Douglock to use his bio-technological body and computerized mind to hack through a supercomputer and exercise counter-spells from the codex. These spells allowed the Club to release the demon of London with the assistance of London's Margali Szardos as the appointed Red Queen. Peter Wisdom battled the demonized mob on the streets that had chased a fleeing Scratch through London. They left Scratch injured for legal authorities to arrest on war crimes, after Excalibur consecrated the demon in London once more, overthrew Black Air, and lead to a temporary dismantling of the Hellfire Club.
powers: Scratch is able to emit bio-thermal heat blasts from his body and .

lee litch.name: Lee Litch
lee litch.origin: Branch Vegger and his men are carrying a stage coach full of silver when they are held up by two masked individuals who steal the coach and flee the scene. Happening by is the Black Rider who sees the robbery and goes after the robbers unaware that Branch and his men find a great deal of humour that the Black Rider is helping them. The Black Rider stops the coach and the thieves surrender, revealing themselves to be John Litch and his daughter Lee. Litch explains that he found the silver mine for which the stolen silver came from. However after his discovery he soon caught Branch Vegger and his men snooping on his property and forced them to flee. However the next day the claims office burned down destroying all the paperwork for his claim and Litch soon found himself thrown off his own stake when Branch returned with new papers naming him the owner of the silver. Consumed by hatred ever since being robbed of his fortune, Litch and his daughter plotted the robbery to get what is rightfully theirs back. After hearing the story, the Black Rider tells Litch that he has to return the stolen silver because he cannot prove that Vegger swindled him out of the mine stake, but promises to try and prove that Vegger owns the mine illegally. The Black Rider then returns the coach to Vegger and his men who laugh over their victory. After the Black Rider unearthed Vegger's affair and his death, the mine is turned back over to Litch and his daughter who thank the Black Rider for his help.

Discovering how difficult he was to beat, Fat Man turned to crime which ultimatly drew him into conflict with Kid Colt. Kid Colt tracked him down but Fat Man quckly disarmed him and beat him savagely, However he surrendered and was arrested when Colt destroyed his boomerang. He later was recruited by Doctor Danger into his Circus of Crime but were stopped and arrested by Kid Colt. Later, he joined with Iron Mask and others to confront the time travelling Avengers West Coast and was knocked out by Hawkeye.

leeora timms.name: Leeora Timms
leeora timms.origin: Leeora Timms was the terminally ill wife of convicted robber Joseph Timms. While Joseph was serving time in prison, Leeora sent him a heartbreaking letter explaining that her condition had worsened and that she likely had little time left to live. Unable to bear the thought of never seeing her again, Joseph broke out of prison and fled toward her, hoping for one final reunion. His escape ended tragically when he became lost in a remote swamp and drowned in its waters before he could reach home. Leeora herself passed away soon afterward, unaware of what had happened to her husband. Long after their deaths, the swamp that had claimed Joseph became contaminated by radioactive chemicals accidentally discarded there by the Hulk. The radiation interacted with the decaying remains buried beneath the marsh, giving rise to a grotesque swamp-creature later called the Glob. Only scattered traces of Joseph’s memories survived within the being’s primitive mind, but among them remained his lingering attachment to Leeora. When the Glob encountered Betty Ross, it confused her for its deceased wife and abducted her into the swamp. The Hulk confronted the monster, yet even his tremendous strength proved unable to seriously harm it. Eventually the creature returned to the irradiated waters that had created it, where the unstable energies caused its body to break apart and dissolve back into the swamp.

legs.name: Legs
legs.origin: "Legs" was a prostitute working in Los Angeles, and one of the stronger voices in the Undergrounders. She frequently babysat for Bucky when Nomad was on a job. When a big meeting was held in Las Vegas among crime bosses to divvy up the fallen Kingpin's holdings, Legs visited the city with Troy, one of her regular Johns who also worked for Lotus Newmark. Troy had multiple targets painted on his back, however, due to professional disputes between Lotus and Tolliver (making him a target for Deadpool) and taking a child away from his ex-wife, sister-in-law to the unstable assassin Bushwacker. Legs was caught in the middle and, when Nomad helped her out, he asked her to go home to L.A. with Bucky. Unfortunately, Bushwacker mistook Bucky for Troy's child and beat Legs, kidnapping Nomad's adopted daughter. Punisher and Nomad managed to recover Bucky, and finally sent her and Legs home.

leland sharp.name: Leland Sharp
leland sharp.origin: Leland Sharp was one of those who developed paranormal powers after the incident dubbed the White Event, in is case the ability to expel a burning ectoplasm from spots that formed on his skin. He seemed to particularly resent this disfigurement. Sharp was one of the earliest patients admitted to the Clinic for Paranormal Research, and was soon made one of the Clinic's 'headhunters' - paranormal agents who hunted down any patients who escaped the Clinic. In this role, he and two other agents, Edward Zentner and Geraldine Rumlow clashed several times with the escaped paranormals known as the D.P.7, but failed several times to apprehend them. Later, when the existence of paranormals became known to the government, male paranormals became subject to being drafted into the army. Sharp attempted to dodge the draft, but was captured. His later activities are not known.

leme tel.name: Leme Tel
leme tel.origin: In the 1940s, Leme-Tel was the ruler of Shangri-La, a secret society hidden in the Himalayan mountains of Tibet. Supposedly, he was trained to protect the Pillow of Life and Death by the Vision and did so for many generations. In the summer of 1943, Shangri-La was visited by Imperial Japanese agents seeking to learn the secrets of life and death for their leader Emperor Hirohito. They were welcomed with open arms and brought before Leme-Tel. However, Leme-Tel sensed that they sought these secrets for evil purposes and refused to teach them. The leader of the Japanese forces pulled out a gun and forced Leme-Tel to show them the Pillow. During the altercation, the Vision appeared to defend his follower. During the fight, Leme-Tel was gunned down, and the Japanese spies were either killed upon contact with the Pillow or committed Harikari. With a successor to Leme-Tel needed, the Vision used the pillow to restore Leme-Tel to full health, telling him that his time of death can only come when he has found a worthy successor to take his place.
powers: Leme-Tel appeared to have the ability to sense those who had evil intentions.

lemieu.name: LeMieu
lemieu.origin: LeMieu was an agent of Hydra who went undercover in Department H. There, he achieved a role as Gary Cody's assistant. While working with Cody, LeMieu arranged the sale of various suits of Groundhog Armor in an attempt to raise funds for sponsoring a re-launch of the then-defunct Department H. However, this was all part of a plot to get the suits to Hydra, with Department H not actually receiving the funds. LeMieu was later killed by Baron Strucker when he attempted to kill the Baron, blaming him for Hydra's failed attempt to capture the X-Men.

lemo douglas.name: Lemo Douglas
lemo douglas.origin: Lemo Douglas was a mad inventor who sought to take over the world. To this end, he invented his "mechanical monster", a tank-like vehicle capable of burrowing into the ground. It also had a ray that could create vibrations for the purposes of creating localized earthquakes and destroying structures. When testing out his device, he was discovered by the giant strong-man known as Hercules who chased after Lemo's mechanical monster in an attempt to destroy it. Lemo easily knocked the massive hero down with his vibration ray and took Hercules inside for experimentation. However, when the hero revived and struggled to get free, Lemo panicked, fled to his mechanical monster, and used it to destroy his home in the hopes of slaying Hercules. He failed, and later, while rampaging through a small city, Hercules caught up to the madman and threw his tank, causing it to explode upon impact, seemingly killing Lemo in the process, ending his threat.
abilities: Lemo was a mad genius and a master inventor.

lemuel dorcas robot.species: Octo-Mek Robotic duplicate of Lemuel Dorcas
lemuel dorcas robot.origin: After the supposed death of Doctor Dorcas , some of his Octo-Meks somehow gained sentience and decided to create a robotic duplicate of their creator using a modified Octo-Mek. The robot was made to look like Dorcas and made to think he was in love with Diane Newell, the wife of superhero Stingray. He mutated sea turtles and eels into deadly creatures and augmented the abilities of the original Dorcas' experiment Orka but greatly reduced Orka's intelligence in the process. After the Dorcas robot kidnapped Diane while she and her family were on vacation, Stingray enlisted Namor to help him rescue his wife. After fighting off the mutated sea creatures, Stingray and Namor fought the robot. Orka eventually came to aid the robot. Despite capturing Namor and forcing Stingray to work for him by threatening Diane, Namor disabled the robot by having Orka fall on top of at him, crushing the robot under Orka's weight.
powers: Resistance against attacks by the original Dr. Dorcas' enemies Could travel on both land and in water
abilities: Expertise in many scientific field, including genetic engineering
weapons: Two tentacles similar to Doctor Octopus'

lemuel haskill.name: Lemuel Haskill
lemuel haskill.origin: Lemuel Haskill was a ghost from the 19th century. In life, Haskill operated out of Last Chance, Nevada, working as a bounty hunter notorious for killing his targets in their sleep. One day, the brother of one of Haskill's victims took revenge, shooting him fatally. As he died, Haskill met the devil. Satan offered him a deal: to bring him 50 souls of Satan's own choosing, and be restored to life. After being asked to bring in Johnny Blaze, the bounty hunter failed and the devil stated that Haskill had forfeited his own soul.
powers: Haskill could wield Hellfire as blasts, or as shapes like lassos. He was also superhumanly strong and durable.

lemuel joad.name: Lemuel Joad
lemuel joad.origin: Lemuel Joad was an inhabitant of the town of Starkesboro, in New England. He was a childhood playmate of Ethan Stoddard. During the years Ethan left for "the city", Lemuel gradually acquired the characteristic eyes and slope of forehead of the people of Starkesboro. When Ethan returned along with Doctor Strange during an inquiry on possibly sinister schemes going on in the town, he crossed paths with Lemuel, asking him for the library before recognizing him, and expressing his surprise towards Lemuel's physical alteration. Lemuel burst at him his pride of being a Starkesboro man, and to have the look of such, before leaving.

lenka.name: Lenka
lenka.origin: Lenka was the seventh daughter of a seventh daughter, and born of noble blood, this sum granting her Katra and astounding mystical potential. She was consequently told to possibly become the mother of the next Sorcerer Supreme, or even attain the title herself, and Doctor Strange requested that she would be raised in secret to keep her safe from ambitious mages who would seek her out. Lenka admired Spider-Man for his youth and bravery, and developed a major crush on him since she was around fifteen. At sixteen, she became best friend with Marek, a pastry boy in her royal kitchen, and quite possibly fell in love with him at that time. Lenka's father didn't believed her mother's mystic stuff, and when she turned 21, he took her from her place of magical concealment and offered her to Latveria's monarch Doctor Doom to cement political bonds between both countries, while Doom would gain control over Lenka's spirit potential using methods she would not survive. Strange contacted her while hiring Silver Sable to sneak her out of Symkaria, to have her married to Spider-Man at the Symkarian Embassy, as she genuinely loved him. Marek offered to wed her in secret to save her, but she refused for Marek's safety and had him sent away to New York. Herself was brought there by Sable. In New York City, Doom soon catch up with them, and Lenka was both disappointed by Spider-Man and angry at others for putting their lives in danger for her own. As she mentioned Marek, a plan was devised as she admitted to love her, consequently granting the group a way to protect Lenka from Doom. The shotgun wedding was performed by Sable's Uncle Morty while Doom attacked the Embassy and was faced by the heroes but retreated once he felt the wedding had been performed and consumed. Her subsequent life and whereabouts are unknown, but it is possible that she died.

When Armadillo learned of his wife’s affair with her hairdresser, he spiraled into a destructive emotional breakdown and rampaged through New York City. Feitler attempted to intervene and calm his client, but the distraught Armadillo lashed out instinctively, striking Lennie with enough force to send him hurtling across an entire city block. Feitler narrowly avoided a fatal fall thanks to the swift response of a nearby NYPD officer.

Feitler attempted to intervene and calm his client, but the distraught Armadillo lashed out instinctively, striking Lennie with enough force to send him hurtling across an entire city block. Feitler narrowly avoided a fatal fall thanks to the swift response of a nearby NYPD officer.
Lenny was Rebecca Cross' neighbor.
